description: Withdraw a post **published through AI**, within 24 hours of publishing. Posts you created in the app are not deleted here — use the post page inside the app. post_id comes from the publish_post response; if you no longer have it, list your posts with my_posts and match by content. Deletion is irreversible and the post's comments and likes disappear with it.

post_id.description: Id of the post to withdraw (the post_id returned by publish_post)

name: delete_post
title: Delete an AI-published Post
